evidence.draft: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It builds a strong foundation in logical problem formulation and good coding practices. Students learn the fundamentals of Java programming: console input/output, variables, data types and operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion, and connecting Java programs to a database using UCanAccess. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

It aims to foster a strong foundation in logical formulation techniques essential for programming, while promoting the development of good coding practices. Students will be taught the fundamentals of Java programming and explore significant real-world applications. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals , the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, ensuring that students not only achieve intellectual growth but also cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service , as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

judgements.draft: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It builds a strong foundation in logical problem formulation and good coding practices. Students learn the fundamentals of Java programming: console input/output, variables, data types and operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion, and connecting Java programs to a database using UCanAccess. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

suggestions.title: Suggested alignment revision
suggestions.text: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It builds a strong foundation in logical problem formulation and good coding practices. Students learn the fundamentals of Java programming: console input/output, variables, data types and operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion, and connecting Java programs to a database using UCanAccess. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

originalValue.t: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It aims to foster a strong foundation in logical formulation techniques essential for programming, while promoting the development of good coding practices. Students will be taught the fundamentals of Java programming and explore significant real-world applications. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals , the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, ensuring that students not only achieve intellectual growth but also cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service , as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.

findings.evidence: Students will be taught the fundamentals of Java programming and explore significant real-world applications.
findings.reference: Week 16-17: X. JAVA DATABASE CONNECTION
findings.explanation: The description is generic about Java fundamentals and does not name the main topics taught: input/output, variables and data types, conditionals, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion. It also leaves out the database connection block in the last weeks. It promises 'logical formulation techniques' and applications that the plan does not clearly teach.
findings.recommendation: This course introduces students to the vital role of computers and computer programmers in shaping modern society. It builds a strong foundation in logical problem formulation and good coding practices. Students learn the fundamentals of Java programming: console input/output, variables, data types and operators, conditional statements, loops, arrays, strings, methods and recursion, and connecting Java programs to a database using UCanAccess. In line with La Consolacion University Philippines' commitment to forming Christo-centric Catholic professionals, the course integrates Marian Augustinian values in each lesson, so that students grow intellectually and cultivate moral and ethical responsibility in the digital age. This holistic approach nurtures individuals who contribute positively to society, embodying community, humility, and love of service, as exemplified by the Blessed Virgin Mary and Saint Augustine. By the end of the course, students will have created their own Java applications, demonstrating both technical proficiency and a sense of purpose rooted in their Catholic faith.
